title: Authentication timeout on API gateway
description: Users experiencing 401 errors after 15 minutes of inactivity. Session tokens expiring prematurely.
root_cause: JWT token expiration set to 900 seconds instead of 3600 seconds in config
solution: Updated JWT_EXPIRATION environment variable from 900 to 3600 in config/auth.py

code_change.after: JWT_EXPIRATION = 3600  # 1 hour

title: Database connection pool exhausted during peak hours
description: Application crashes with 'Too many connections' error during high traffic periods.
root_cause: Connection pool size set to default 10, insufficient for production load
solution: Increased max_pool_size to 50 and added connection timeout handling

code_change.after: client = MongoClient(uri, maxPoolSize=50, serverSelectionTimeoutMS=5000)

title: Memory leak in background task processor
description: Worker process memory grows continuously until OOM crash after 6 hours of runtime.
root_cause: Task results stored in memory without cleanup, list growing unbounded
solution: Implemented result cleanup after processing and added max queue size limit

title: CORS error blocking frontend requests from subdomain
description: Browser console shows 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' error when calling API from app.subdomain.com
root_cause: CORS middleware only allowing exact domain match, not wildcard subdomains
solution: Updated CORS configuration to allow all subdomains of main domain

code_change.after:
ALLOWED_ORIGINS = ['https://example.com', 'https://*.example.com']
app.add_middleware(CORSMiddleware, allow_origin_regex=r'https://.*\.example\.com')

title: Null pointer exception in user profile update
description: 500 error when updating user profile without providing optional 'bio' field.
root_cause: Missing null check for optional fields before accessing .strip() method
solution: Added null safety checks for all optional profile fields

code_change.after: bio = data.get('bio', '').strip() if data.get('bio') else None

title: Rate limiter blocking legitimate user requests
description: Users behind corporate NAT getting 429 Too Many Requests despite individual compliance.
root_cause: Rate limit applied per IP address, not per authenticated user
solution: Changed rate limiting strategy to use user_id for authenticated requests

title: JSON serialization error for datetime objects
description: API returning 'Object of type datetime is not JSON serializable' error.
root_cause: Datetime objects from database not converted to ISO format strings before JSON response
solution: Added custom JSON encoder for datetime serialization

title: Webhook delivery failing with SSL verification error
description: Outgoing webhooks to partner API failing with 'SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED'.
root_cause: Partner using self-signed certificate, requests library rejecting by default
solution: Added certificate bundle configuration and fallback for trusted self-signed certs

code_change.after:
import certifi
response = requests.post(
    webhook_url,
    json=payload,
    verify=certifi.where(),
    timeout=10
)

title: Race condition in order processing
description: Duplicate orders created when user double-clicks submit button.
root_cause: No idempotency key validation, allowing duplicate submissions
solution: Implemented idempotency key checking using Redis cache with 5-minute TTL

title: Email notifications not sending in production
description: Users not receiving password reset emails, no errors in logs.
root_cause: SMTP port 25 blocked by cloud provider, need to use port 587 with TLS
solution: Updated SMTP configuration to use port 587 with STARTTLS

code_change.after:
smtp = smtplib.SMTP(smtp_host, 587)
smtp.starttls()
smtp.login(smtp_user, smtp_password)

title: Pagination returning duplicate results
description: Users seeing the same items on multiple pages when scrolling through list.
root_cause: Using OFFSET pagination with ORDER BY non-unique field (created_at), causing unstable ordering
solution: Added secondary sort by unique ID field for stable pagination

code_change.after: query = query.order_by('-created_at', '-id').limit(page_size).offset(offset)

title: File upload failing for files > 1MB
description: Large file uploads returning 413 Request Entity Too Large error.
root_cause: Nginx default client_max_body_size is 1MB, need to increase for production
solution: Updated Nginx configuration and Flask MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH

code_change.after: client_max_body_size 10M;

title: Cache returning stale data after updates
description: Users seeing old profile information even after successful update.
root_cause: Cache invalidation not triggered on UPDATE operations, only on DELETE
solution: Added cache invalidation for all write operations (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE)

title: Search returning no results for special characters
description: Search queries with apostrophes or quotes returning empty results.
root_cause: Special characters not escaped in MongoDB regex query, breaking pattern matching
solution: Added regex escape function for user input before search query

title: Timezone mismatch in scheduled reports
description: Daily reports generating at wrong time, showing data from wrong day.
root_cause: Server using UTC but report logic assuming local timezone without conversion
solution: Added explicit timezone handling using pytz for report date calculations

code_change.before:
from datetime import datetime
today = datetime.now().date()
code_change.after:
from datetime import datetime
import pytz

user_tz = pytz.timezone(user.timezone or 'UTC')
today = datetime.now(user_tz).date()

title: API key validation failing intermittently
description: Valid API keys randomly rejected with 401 Unauthorized error.
root_cause: API key lookup using case-sensitive comparison, keys stored in mixed case
solution: Normalized API keys to lowercase for storage and comparison

code_change.after:
api_key = request.headers.get('X-API-Key', '').lower()
if db.api_keys.find_one({'key': api_key}):

title: Slow query causing timeout on analytics dashboard
description: Analytics page loading for 30+ seconds then timing out.
root_cause: Missing database index on frequently queried timestamp field
solution: Added compound index on (user_id, timestamp) for analytics queries

code_change.after:
db.analytics.create_index([('user_id', 1), ('timestamp', -1)])
db.analytics.create_index([('timestamp', -1)])  # For date range queries

title: Password reset token not expiring
description: Security audit found password reset links remain valid indefinitely.
root_cause: Token expiration check missing in password reset validation logic
solution: Added token expiration validation using timestamp comparison

title: WebSocket connection dropping after 60 seconds
description: Real-time notifications stop working after 1 minute of connection.
root_cause: Load balancer idle timeout set to 60 seconds, no keepalive ping implemented
solution: Implemented WebSocket ping/pong mechanism every 30 seconds

title: Data export generating corrupted CSV files
description: Downloaded CSV files have garbled characters for non-ASCII text.
root_cause: CSV export not specifying UTF-8 encoding, defaulting to ASCII
solution: Added explicit UTF-8 encoding with BOM for Excel compatibility

code_change.before:
with open(filename, 'w', newline='') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
code_change.after:
with open(filename, 'w', newline='', encoding='utf-8-sig') as f:
    writer = csv.writer(f)
